worldcombat.skill.liquidation.summary: Compress water into a close-fitting blade and ram the target: it hits, shoves, and leaves the target soaked, with a chance to crack its Defence down. While the user stands in rain, the water presses harder.
worldcombat.skill.liquidation.use.0: Ram one target wrapped in water
worldcombat.skill.liquidation.use.2: Leave the target soaked for later water moves
worldcombat.skill.liquidation.descriptio: The hit deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block water-blade radius; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.

A landed hit has a %1$s chance to crack the armour, lowering the target's Defence by %2$s stage(s) and leaving a mark that its armour is sundered; if the target is not already wet, it is also left soaked for %3$s for later water moves.
Charge up to %1$s blocks along your aim at %2$s blocks per tick; it stops at the first target and shoves it about %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.liquidation.shred.on: Sundering form: a higher crack chance, two stages at once and longer soak, but less direct power and a longer preparation and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.liquidation.shred.off: Crushing form: more direct power and one stage of Defence drop, and it comes out sooner.
worldcombat.skill.liquidation.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.liquidation.growth.0: At level %1$s, the ram power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.liquidation.growth.1: At level %1$s, the ram power rises to %2$s and the crack chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.liquidation.preference: On: a higher crack chance, two stages at once and a longer soak, but less direct power and a longer preparation and cooldown. Off: the crushing form, more direct power and one stage of Defence drop.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of using Liquidation. Larger values chase harder.
On: prefer targets whose armour is not yet sundered (so the hit lands the crack). Off: order by threat and distance only.
